primitives.name: Collision Refinement Loop
primitives.verbatim_quote: The paper's numbers forbid any stronger use: 6.69% binary agreement on sports-injury low-filter means the SLM's positive calls are wrong ~14 times out of 15.
primitives.assumptions: iLQR collision refinement must exceed kinematics-only baseline by ≥10% e_MPJPE and ≥50% e_{foot,vxy}.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When empirical weight tuning fails to meet performance thresholds on released datasets.

layer2.mapping: Enables dynamic adjustment of physical simulation weights via Bayesian optimization, aligning with GSI's need for validated pose estimation.
layer2.telemetry: Reduction in e_MPJPE and e_{foot,vxy} relative to baseline.

primitives.name: Constraint Sequence Modeling
primitives.verbatim_quote: Improvement experiment Replace the BiGRU CTX with a constrained decoding step: a learned NFL play-grammar (down/distance → legal next events) as hard constraints on the event sequence, instead of a learned sequence refiner.
primitives.assumptions: Play-grammar constraints reduce invalid sequences to zero on test set.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When unconstrained sequence models produce logically invalid event chains.

layer2.mapping: Maps NFL event sequences to formal grammatical structures, enabling GSE’s conversational layer to enforce logical consistency in data interpretation.
layer2.telemetry: Zero invalid sequences vs empirical reduction in CTX.

primitives.name: Parallel Agent Execution
primitives.verbatim_quote: Improvement experiment Close GridMind's two admitted gaps in one design: (a) replace their 17.5 s sequential pipeline with parallel agent execution + query-result caching (measure p50/p95 latency vs theirs); (b) replace their 10-person subjective alpha with the deterministic eval in §12 (executed-query ground truth).
primitives.assumptions: Parallelism reduces latency below 17.5s while maintaining deterministic evaluation fidelity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When sequential processing exceeds acceptable latency thresholds.

layer2.mapping: Enables scalable conversational AI in GSE by replacing serial agent workflows with concurrent execution and caching mechanisms.
layer2.telemetry: p50/p95 latency comparison against GridMind’s sequential pipeline.
